choices: Producing two products together lowers cost
Cost per unit falls with cumulative output
A product becomes more valuable to each user as more people use it
Average cost falls as output rises
explain: Value to users rises with the number of users.

stem: True or false: A new platform with a better product can easily beat an incumbent platform with strong network effects.
choices: True
False
explain: False. Users are locked in: switching alone gains nothing, so a better product with few users is worth less to each user.

stem: What is critical mass in a network market?
choices: The largest number of users a network can serve
The number of firms a market can support
The number of users needed before the network keeps growing on its own
The output at which average cost is lowest
explain: Below critical mass the network stalls; above it, it is attractive enough to keep adding users.

stem: KSL Classifieds beat Craigslist in Utah (S18 slides p. 39). Which barrier protected KSL once it had the local buyers and sellers?
choices: Patents
Network effects
Learning curve
Economies of scope
explain: Buyers go where sellers are and sellers go where buyers are.

stem: True or false: In a two-way network, adding one more user benefits the users already on the network.
choices: True
False
explain: True. A new user adds 2n connections; every existing user can now reach one more person.

In 2022 Q2 Twitter had 237.8 million daily users and $1,076 million of advertising revenue. What was its ad revenue per user?
explain: 1,076 / 237.8 = $4.52 per user for the quarter, versus $14.29 for Meta.

stem: In 2022 Q2 Snapchat had 347 million daily users, $1,111 million of revenue and $1,512 million of operating expense. What was its profit per user? (Negative for a loss.)
explain: Revenue per user = 1,110.9 / 347 = $3.20. Cost per user = 1,511.8 / 347 = $4.36. Profit per user = 3.20 - 4.36 = -$1.16.

stem: Using the exercise data, why did Meta earn about three times Twitter's ad revenue per user in 2022?
choices: Meta spent less on R&D
Network effects: more users and data make each ad more valuable to advertisers
Meta charged users a subscription fee
Twitter used limit pricing
explain: More users and engagement mean more data for targeting and more reach for advertisers, so each user brings in more ad revenue.

stem: Which pair best matches the exercise's conclusion about Meta's advantages?
choices: Revenue advantage from economies of scale; cost advantage from network effects
Revenue advantage from network effects; cost advantage from economies of scale
Both from patents
Both from limit pricing
explain: Network effects raise what each user is worth to advertisers; scale spreads mostly fixed infrastructure over more users.
